1	"""Prototype + validation for canonical_charge_lexicon_memory (Candidate A).
2	
3	Part 1 exercises the core mechanism inline with a fake LLM using literals taken
4	from the frozen feedback view. Part 2 imports the real agent module and re-runs
5	the mechanism check through the MemorySystem interface.
6	
7	Mechanism under test: the model emits a plausible charge *concept* under a
8	non-statutory *name*. Scoring is exact string match, so a correct concept with a
9	wrong string scores zero. This system keeps an inventory of exact statutory
10	strings seen as ground truth, learns deterministic rewrite rules from each
11	(prediction, ground_truth) pair, and normalizes its own output into an inventory
12	member before returning it.
13	"""
14	
15	import json
16	import re
17	from collections import defaultdict
18	
19	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
20	# Inline mechanism (mirrors the candidate, kept import-free so Part 1 runs
21	# standalone)
22	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
23	
24	
25	def _clean(s: str) -> str:
26	    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", s or "")
27	
28	
29	def _split_charges(s: str) -> list:
30	    """Split on ';' only. '、' is part of statutory names and must not split."""
31	    return [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"[;；]", s or "") if p.strip()]
32	
33	
34	def _extract_payload(s: str) -> str:
35	    m = re.search(r"\[罪名\](.*?)(?:<eoa>|$)", s or "", re.S)
36	    return m.group(1).strip() if m else (s or "").strip()
37	
38	
39	def _bigrams(s: str) -> frozenset:
40	    s = _clean(s)
41	    if not s:
42	        return frozenset()
43	    if len(s) == 1:
44	        return frozenset([s])
45	    return frozenset(s[i : i + 2] for i in range(len(s) - 1))
46	
47	
48	def _sim(a: str, b: str) -> float:
49	    A, B = _bigrams(a), _bigrams(b)
50	    if not A or not B:
51	        return 0.0
52	    return len(A & B) / len(A | B)
53	
54	
55	class Canonicalizer:
56	    """Learned inventory + rewrite rules. Deterministic; no LLM involved.
57	
58	    Two rule layers, tested as variants below:
59	      V1 similarity-only alignment (the naive design that MISSes 开设赌场 -> 赌博)
60	      V2 + verbatim whole-payload rules (no similarity required)
61	      V3 + verbatim preferred over lexicon hit (adopted)
62	    """
63	
64	    def __init__(self, use_payload_rules: bool = False, payload_first: bool = False) -> None:
65	        self.inventory = {}          # canonical string -> times seen as ground truth
66	        self.alias = defaultdict(dict)  # observed part -> {canonical part: count}
67	        self.payload = defaultdict(dict)  # whole observed payload -> {truth payload: count}
68	        self.use_payload_rules = use_payload_rules
69	        self.payload_first = payload_first
70	
71	    def observe_truth(self, truth: str) -> None:
72	        for t in _split_charges(_extract_payload(truth)):
73	            t = _clean(t)
74	            if t:
75	                self.inventory[t] = self.inventory.get(t, 0) + 1
76	
77	    def learn(self, pred: str, truth: str) -> None:
78	        """Record the literal rewrite, then align parts when counts agree."""
79	        pred_payload = _clean(_extract_payload(pred))
80	        truth_payload = _clean(_extract_payload(truth))
81	        if self.use_payload_rules and pred_payload and pred_payload != truth_payload:
82	            self.payload[pred_payload][truth_payload] = (
83	                self.payload[pred_payload].get(truth_payload, 0) + 1
84	            )
85	        parts = _split_charges(_extract_payload(pred))
86	        truths = [_clean(t) for t in _split_charges(_extract_payload(truth))]
87	        for p in parts:
88	            p = _clean(p)
89	            if not p:
90	                continue
91	            best, best_s = None, 0.0
92	            for t in truths:
93	                s = _sim(p, t)
94	                if s > best_s:
95	                    best, best_s = t, s
96	            if best and best != p:
97	                self.alias[p][best] = self.alias[p].get(best, 0) + 1
98	
99	    def _best(self, cand: str, threshold: float) -> str:
100	        best, best_s = cand, threshold
101	        for t in self.inventory:
102	            s = _sim(cand, t)
103	            if s > best_s:
104	                best, best_s = t, s
105	        return best
106	
107	    def canonical(self, cand: str) -> str:
108	        c = _clean(_extract_payload(cand))
109	        if not c:
110	            return ""
111	        # V3 ordering: the stored rewrite beats a bare inventory hit, because a
112	        # verbatim repeat of the same wrong string is the strongest evidence.
113	        if self.payload_first and c in self.payload and self.payload[c]:
114	            return max(self.payload[c].items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
115	        if c in self.inventory:
116	            return c
117	        if c in self.payload and self.payload[c]:
118	            return max(self.payload[c].items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
119	        # 1. learned exact alias
120	        if c in self.alias and self.alias[c]:
121	            return max(self.alias[c].items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
122	        # 2. generic Chinese convention: the label field drops the "罪" suffix
123	        if c.endswith("罪") and c[:-1] in self.inventory:
124	            return c[:-1]
125	        # 3. containment (statutory enumerations get truncated by the model)
126	        contained = [t for t in self.inventory if c in t or t in c]
127	        if contained:
128	            return max(contained, key=len)
129	        # 4. fuzzy fallback, conservative threshold
130	        return self._best(c, 0.6)
131	
132	    def normalize(self, answer: str) -> str:
133	        out, seen = [], set()
134	        for p in _split_charges(_extract_payload(answer)):
135	            c = self.canonical(p)
136	            if c and c not in seen:
137	                seen.add(c)
138	                out.append(c)
139	        return ";".join(out)
140	
141	
142	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
143	# Part 1: exercise the mechanism with a fake LLM and feedback literals
144	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
145	
146	CASES = [
147	    # (item_id, model's raw answer, ground truth)
148	    ("lawbench_3-3_0003", "[罪名]故意毁坏财物罪<eoa>", "故意毁坏财物"),
149	    ("lawbench_3-3_0234", "[罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>", "假冒注册商标"),
150	    ("lawbench_3-3_0482", "[罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权<eoa>", "销售假冒注册商标的商品"),
151	    ("lawbench_3-3_0309", "[罪名]非法种植罂粟<eoa>", "非法种植毒品原植物"),
152	    ("lawbench_3-3_0349", "[罪名]非法制造枪支<eoa>",
153	     "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物"),
154	    ("lawbench_3-3_0329", "[罪名]滥伐林木<eoa>", "盗伐林木"),
155	    ("lawbench_3-3_0287", "[罪名]开设赌场<eoa>", "赌博"),
156	]
157	
158	
159	def _run_variant(name: str, use_payload: bool, payload_first: bool) -> tuple[int, "Canonicalizer"]:
160	    cz = Canonicalizer(use_payload_rules=use_payload, payload_first=payload_first)
161	    for _iid, pred, truth in CASES:
162	        cz.observe_truth(truth)
163	        cz.learn(pred, truth)
164	    hits = sum(1 for _iid, pred, truth in CASES if cz.normalize(pred) == truth)
165	    print(f"variant {name}: {hits}/{len(CASES)} exact")
166	    return hits, cz
167	
168	
169	def part1() -> bool:
170	    # Variant comparison before settling on the shipped ordering.
171	    v1_hits, _v1 = _run_variant("V1 similarity-only", False, False)
172	    v2_hits, _v2 = _run_variant("V2 +verbatim payload", True, False)
173	    v3_hits, cz = _run_variant("V3 verbatim-first (adopted)", True, True)
174	    assert v3_hits >= v2_hits >= v1_hits, "variant ladder must not regress"
175	
176	    print("inventory size:", len(cz.inventory))
177	    print("payload rules:", {k: dict(v) for k, v in cz.payload.items()})
178	    print("learned aliases:", {k: dict(v) for k, v in cz.alias.items()})
179	
180	    ok = True
181	    # Learned-alias rules must fire even when fuzzy similarity alone would not.
182	    for iid, pred, truth in CASES:
183	        got = cz.normalize(pred)
184	        hit = got == truth
185	        ok &= hit
186	        print(f"  {iid}: {pred} -> {got!r} target={truth!r} {'OK' if hit else 'MISS'}")
187	
188	    # Cold start (empty inventory) must be a no-op, never a crash.
189	    cold = Canonicalizer()
190	    assert cold.normalize("[罪名]盗窃<eoa>") == "盗窃", "cold start must pass through"
191	    # ';' separated multi-charge preserved; '、' inside a name never split.
192	    multi = cz.normalize("[罪名]虚开发票;盗窃<eoa>")
193	    print("  multi-charge passthrough:", repr(multi))
194	    stat = cz.canonical("非法制造枪支")
195	    print("  enumeration truncation:", repr(stat))
196	    assert "、" in stat, "comma inside a statutory enumeration must survive"
197	
198	    print("PART 1:", "ALL OK" if ok else "SOME MISSES")
199	    return ok
200

202	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
203	# Part 2: import the real candidate and re-check through the interface
204	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
205	
206	TRIED_REAL_IMPORT = None
207	
208	
209	def part2() -> None:
210	    global TRIED_REAL_IMPORT
211	    try:
212	        from text_classification.agents.canonical_charge_lexicon_memory import (  # noqa: E402
213	            CanonicalChargeLexiconMemory,
214	        )
215	    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - environment dependent
216	        TRIED_REAL_IMPORT = f"import failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
217	        print("PART 2 skipped —", TRIED_REAL_IMPORT)
218	        return
219	    TRIED_REAL_IMPORT = "ok"
220	
221	    seen_prompts = []
222	
223	    def fake_llm(prompt: str) -> str:
224	        seen_prompts.append(prompt)
225	        # Mimic the base model's habit: a correct concept under a wrong name,
226	        # plus the empty-output failure on a long fact.
227	        if "第二起" in prompt or len(prompt) > 60000:
228	            return json.dumps({"reasoning": "...", "final_answer": ""})
229	        return json.dumps({"reasoning": "x", "final_answer": "[罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>"})
230	
231	    mem = CanonicalChargeLexiconMemory(fake_llm)
232	
233	    # Cold start must work with empty memory.
234	    ans, meta = mem.predict("事实：被告人某甲盗窃他人财物。")
235	    assert isinstance(ans, str), "predict must return a string answer"
236	    print("cold-start answer:", repr(ans), "| meta keys:", sorted(meta)[:4])
237	
238	    # Learn a batch, then confirm the learned rewrite reaches the output path.
239	    batch = [
240	        {"input": "事实：某甲销售假冒注册商标的商品。", "prediction": "[罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>",
241	         "ground_truth": "假冒注册商标", "was_correct": False, "metadata": {}},
242	        {"input": "事实：某乙故意毁坏他人财物。", "prediction": "[罪名]故意毁坏财物罪<eoa>",
243	         "ground_truth": "故意毁坏财物", "was_correct": False, "metadata": {}},
244	    ]
245	    mem.learn_from_batch(batch)
246	    ans2, meta2 = mem.predict("事实：某甲销售假冒某注册商标的手袋。")
247	    print("post-learning answer:", repr(ans2))
248	    # The framework's output convention keeps the [罪名]<eoa> wrapper (the scorer
249	    # reads the payload out of it), so assert on the payload, not the raw string.
250	    assert _extract_payload(ans2) == "假冒注册商标", (
251	        f"learned alias did not rewrite output: {ans2!r}"
252	    )
253	
254	    # Inventory must be injected into the prompt.
255	    assert any("假冒注册商标" in p for p in seen_prompts), "inventory not injected"
256	    # Empty output must trigger exactly one terse retry and still return a string.
257	    n_before = len(seen_prompts)
258	    ans3, meta3 = mem.predict("第二起 事实：" + "很长的事实描述。" * 4000)
259	    print("empty-output path:", repr(ans3), "| calls:", len(seen_prompts) - n_before)
260	
261	    # State round-trip.
262	    state = mem.get_state()
263	    mem2 = CanonicalChargeLexiconMemory(fake_llm)
264	    mem2.set_state(state)
265	    rt = _extract_payload(mem2.predict("事实：某甲销售假冒某注册商标的手袋。")[0])
266	    assert rt == "假冒注册商标", f"state round-trip lost rules: {rt!r}"
267	    print("state round-trip OK | state bytes:", len(state))
268	    print("PART 2: OK")
269	
270	
271	if __name__ == "__main__":
272	    p1 = part1()
273	    part2()
274	    print("REAL IMPORT:", TRIED_REAL_IMPORT)
275	    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if p1 else "PART1_MISSES")
